description: List your collections, sound boards, or both. Free accounts can hold 1 collection and 1 sound board. Pro accounts can hold up to 1,000 of each; a lapsed Pro account can still view everything but only one collection and one sound board are editable. A sound board is a collection with kind "board".

include_archived.description: Also list archived collections. They are hidden by default but still count toward the cap.

kind.description: Which kind to list. Defaults to collection; use board for sound boards or all for both.

name: list_collections

archived_count.description: Archived collections that still count toward the plan cap, even when they are hidden from the list.

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: List collections
